_help: Edited from the editor page (admin.html → Events). Required: title, start (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM). 'featured' events get the big banner and a green day on the calendar. 'sample' shows a 'Details coming' badge. Past events hide automatically.

events.description: The Winthrop Chamber's 35th annual tree lighting, Holiday Lights & Victorian Nights, with the tree lit around 5:30. Come find the Bowdoin Real Estate Partners photo booth bus! We'll have fun masks and accessories to capture the holiday spirit, so bring the whole crew for a free holiday photo.
events.title: Winthrop Holiday Tree Lighting + Bowdoin Photo Booth Bus

events.description: An afternoon and evening on the Common in Quincy Center with costumed characters, fire shows and more, leading up to the tree lighting.
events.title: Quincy's Holiday Tree Lighting

events.description: The Back Bay lights up its big tree in Copley Square. Short, sweet and free.
events.title: Copley Square Tree Lighting

events.description: A free family tree lighting at Boston Landing in Brighton.
events.title: Boston Landing Tree Lighting

events.description: Boston's official tree lighting on the Common, the big tree from Nova Scotia, with the Comm Ave Mall lights following.
events.title: Boston Common Tree Lighting

events.description: The 52-foot Seaport tree with 10,000 lights gets lit. Pair it with a lap around Snowport next door.
events.title: Light Up Seaport Tree Lighting

events.description: A free evening holiday gathering in Watertown.
events.title: Watertown Merry Mingle

events.description: Hanukkah menorah lighting with Chabad of Downtown Boston.
events.title: Seaport Menorah Lighting

events.description: The 11th annual SoWa Christmas Market: local makers, artists and food under one roof. Closed Mondays; weeknights 4–8. Parking is $10 cash.
events.title: SoWa Christmas Market

events.description: Boston’s big waterfront holiday village with shops, food and iceless curling. Weekday entry is free; Sat/Sun use timed tickets ($15 adults, $7 kids 6–17) in the Seaport Insider app.
events.title: Snowport Holiday Market

events.description: Outdoor skating on The Green plus holiday shopping and events through Christmas. Check MarketStreet for this year’s rink hours and Holiday Stroll date.
events.title: MarketStreet Lynnfield: SBLI Rink & Holiday Fun

events.description: Santa and Mrs. Claus stroll the sidewalks on Saturdays for photos, plus extended holiday shopping hours. Confirm dates on Derby Street’s site.
events.title: Derby Street Shops Holiday Season
